title: Lower: Front Squat + Pull

jumps: Front Squat 2 @ RPE 6 → Hurdle Hops 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Rest 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · no hurdles? Tuck jumps
Side to side over a line
strength: Rest 2:00 · UNLOAD week: lighter on purpose, crisp reps · elbows high
